## Project structure
- Angular 19 dynamic dashboard framework (ngx-dd-ui), JSON-driven dashboards with drag/drop.
- src/app/gadgets/ — gadget components; gadget-grid-cell-host.component.ts is the factory (switch statement) for dynamically creating gadgets.
- src/app/gadgets/common/gadget-common/gadget-base/gadget.base.ts — abstract base class all gadgets extend.
- src/assets/api/library.json — gadget definitions and property schemas.
- src/app/dynamic-form/ — dynamic property configuration form generation system.
- src/app/board/ — dashboard board management.
- src/app/layout/ — layout and grid system.
- Build: `ng build`. Test: `ng test` (Karma/Jasmine). Dev server: `ng serve` on http://localhost:4200/.
